name: Footed cup
dimensions: H. 11.2 x W. 10.3 (across handles) x Diam. 10.1 cm (4 7/16 x 4 1/16 x 4 in.)
summary: Small cup raised on a short circular pedestal foot with one vertically oriented loop handle and a smaller horizontally oriented loop handle on the opposite side; lightly burnished blackened earthenware with incised crosshatched decoration and applique handles. Longshan culture; from Shandong province.
